comparison.objective: Set and lock an angular stop versus align a carriage with a T-rail and slide it through a detent.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires driver-and-wrench countertorque; the rail task requires close-profile insertion, square sliding, and overcoming a spring plunger.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° setting retained through cycles; the rail task requires carriage position past the plunger against an end stop while the rail remains unmoved.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot hardware, but profile insertion through a detent does not test maintaining a calibrated screw setting during jam-nut locking.
